## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An eight-fascicle Qīng-dynasty commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* by **Shū Yù** 書玉 ([書玉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%B8%E7%8E%89)). 初津 *chūjīn* "first ford / initial crossing" is a metaphorical title — the work serves as the introductory study by which the practitioner first approaches the bodhisattva-precepts.

**Abstract**

Shū Yù's commentary is one of the more substantial Qīng-period treatments of the *Fànwǎng jīng*. Aimed at students entering the bodhisattva-precept tradition, the text provides systematic exposition with detailed coverage of practical procedural matters.
